doc: ndtr of a unit periodic fBm (low 1: the cell-size field source), default slope. Slope 3.0. The fBm white noise is the input plan0.white. Measured: every random input nudged by one float64 ulp (8 trials) and numpy.fft replaced by scipy.fft: max |diff| 6.7e-16, so 1e-9 relative / 1e-10 absolute (ndtr is a contraction: its slope is at most 0.4).
